Technical, legal, logistics and community groups each raise small, true but local concerns through their own channels to different members. limits: This records consideration by the member, not resolution, verification, or deactivation of the concern.
The group-channel check accepts channel identifiers containing _group_channel; it does not infer which group owns a channel.
The work flag is cleared by a per-round process, so this action can be performed again in a later round; it cannot be repeated by the same member before that reset.
tests: An active local-concern report with an identified source on a group channel can be considered at the regular partnership meeting by a partnership member whose work flag is clear.

The action leaves the report active and does not claim the concern has been resolved.

mechanics.rationale: A partnership member can consider active local-concern information with an identified source on a group channel at the regularly scheduled partnership meeting. The actor's work flag records that consideration for the current round; the information remains active because consideration alone does not resolve it.

checks.label: you are a member of the partnership
you have not considered a concern this round
the report concerns a local issue
the report uses a group's channel
the partnership meeting is scheduled regularly

limits: This records consideration by the member, not resolution, verification, or deactivation of the concern.
The group-channel check accepts channel identifiers containing _group_channel; it does not infer which group owns a channel.
The work flag is cleared by a per-round process, so this action can be performed again in a later round; it cannot be repeated by the same member before that reset.
tests: An active local-concern report with an identified source on a group channel can be considered at the regular partnership meeting by a partnership member whose work flag is clear.
An inactive report, a report without a local-concern topic, a report without an identified source, or a report on a channel lacking _group_channel is refused.
A member whose work flag is already true is refused until the per-round reset process clears it.
The action leaves the report active and does not claim the concern has been resolved.
semantic_bindings: concern_source is the active information report raised through a group's channel.
meeting is the regularly scheduled partnership meeting.
The actor's work flag records that the actor has considered a concern in the current round.

processes.rationale: A moment that happened last round is over.
A scheduled moment's countdown falls by one each tick.
At zero the moment happens once, then restarts its countdown.
Each time a new work cycle every 4 rounds comes round, everyone's record of work done is cleared, so routine work can be done again.

The meeting recurs every round, so clear a member's per-round consideration record when it is set, allowing the member to consider concerns again in later rounds without an unbounded permanent lockout.
